## Type of change

- [ ] feat: new feature
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] style: no functional change (formatting, etc.)
- [ ] refactor: code change without behavior change
- [ ] perf: performance improvement
- [ ] test: adding/updating tests
- [ ] build/ci: build system or CI changes
- [ ] chore: other

## Checklist

- [ ] Ran `go vet ./...` clean
- [ ] Ran `go build ./...` successfully
- [ ] Frontend builds: `npm run build` and `npm run build:demo`
- [ ] Built and launched the app (`build.ps1` / `build.sh`)
- [ ] Desktop app and web playground render identically (shared `markdown.js`)
